title: IH-Benchmark: A Conflict-Centered Benchmark for Instruction-Hierarchy Robustness in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.25987v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When a language model receives conflicting instructions from different priority levels, which one does it actually follow? This question lies at the heart of reliable LLM deployment. Existing benchmarks answer this only partially, often focusing on a single hierarchy component or adapting public datasets with limited tool-use coverage. We present IH-Benchmark, a conflict-centered benchmark for instruction-hierarchy robustness across direct System $\succ$ User (S $\succ$ U) conflicts and tool-mediated User $\succ$ Tool (U $\succ$ T) conflicts. We organize tests into seven constraint categories according to the higher-priority requirements under evaluation. Each test is evaluated with a uniform binary pass/fail protocol combining a predicate domain-specific language (DSL) with rubric-based LLM judges. translated_title: IH-Benchmark：一个以冲突为中心的大型语言模型指令层级鲁棒性基准测试
translated_abstract: 当语言模型收到来自不同优先级层级的冲突指令时，它实际上会遵循哪一条？这个问题是大语言模型可靠部署的核心。现有基准测试只能部分回答这一问题，通常仅关注单一的层级组件，或者基于工具调用覆盖有限公共数据集进行改编。我们提出了IH-Benchmark，这是一个以冲突为中心的指令层级鲁棒性基准测试，涵盖直接的系统≻用户（S≻U）冲突和工具中介的用户≻工具（U≻T）冲突。我们根据所评估的高优先级要求将测试组织为七个约束类别。每个测试均采用统一的二元通过/失败评估协议，该协议结合了谓词领域特定语言（DSL）与基于评分标准的LLM评判者。我们报告类别平衡的合规率，并单独评估非冲突对照组。我们对32个模型配置的评估……
tldr: 提出了IH-Benchmark，一个以冲突为中心的基准测试，通过七个约束类别和统一的二元评估协议，系统评估大语言模型在直接系统-用户冲突及工具中介用户-工具冲突下的指令层级鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: We present IH-Benchmark, a conflict-centered benchmark that systematically evaluates instruction-hierarchy robustness in LLMs across direct System-User and tool-mediated User-Tool conflicts, organized into seven constraint categories with a uniform binary pass/fail evaluation protocol.
